decision.summary: Two regions stand out: one near index 492–498 with a sharp rise in N/E and dip in U, possibly indicating a step or platform; another near 623–630 with an abrupt multi-sample jump across all axes, suggestive of a sudden displacement event. Both show ambiguous or incomplete returns, warranting closer inspection.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample rise in N and E components (indices ~492–498) followed by sustained elevated levels; U component shows a concurrent drop then partial recovery, suggesting a possible platform or step-like offset with ambiguous return.

Abrupt multi-sample jump in all components around index 625–627 (N from ~4.1 to ~5.4, E from ~0.5 to ~1.3, U from ~-1.2 to ~-0.7), preceded by noise-like fluctuations and followed by a plateau—possible permanent shift or temporary offset with unclear reversal.
